amino_acid_match.definition: 1 if ANY amino-acid annotation of the dbNSFP record (any dbnsfp.aa row, any dbnsfp.hgvsp string) has ref1 and alt1; 0 if a dbnsfp block exists but none matches; NaN without dbnsfp block

match_only_in_a_non_first_dbnsfp_row.meaning: the genomic variant has the ref1>alt1 change, but the scores served belong to another amino-acid change of the same genomic variant (rule R2)

position_check.definition: 1 if a matching annotation also has amino-acid position ref_pos

gnomad_exome.release: gnomAD v2.1.1 exomes, lifted over to GRCh38 (125,748 exomes)

sanity.auroc_note: plausibility check only: each predictor oriented by higher_is_pathogenic, label y, variants covered by that predictor

dbnsfp.coordinates: GRCh38; every dbnsfp block is checked (dbnsfp.chrom / hg38.start / ref / alt = query)
dbnsfp.parser_notes: MyVariant.info dbNSFP parser named in the API metadata (src.dbnsfp.code): https://github.com/biothings/myvariant.info/blob/1c767a2/src/hub/dataload/sources/dbnsfp/dbnsfp_parser_48a_v1.py (consulted 2026-10-06): no gnomAD column is mapped; ";"-separated per-transcript values are split, missing entries dropped and a single remaining value returned as scalar; rows with the same genomic id keep the fields of the first row and only collect the `aa` objects of all rows (function load_file).

gnomad.note: The API metadata gives ONE version string for the whole gnomAD source; the release behind each object is given in af_fields.
gnomad.release_basis: MyVariant.info hub uploader, module docstring "Versions of data" (gnomAD_exome_hg38: v2.1.1 => 2.1.1/exomes/liftover_grch38; gnomAD_genome_hg38: v3.1.1 => 3.1.1/genomes): https://github.com/biothings/myvariant.info/blob/master/src/hub/dataload/sources/gnomad/gnomad_upload.py (last changed by commit b0f5003, 2021-06-10; consulted 2026-10-06). The parsers of that hub read AC / AN / AF / nhomalt per population only, not popmax / grpmax / faf95; a record without FILTER flag (PASS) is stored without `filter` field.

gnomad_exome.gnomad_release: gnomAD v2.1.1 exomes, lifted over to GRCh38 (125,748 exomes)

not_served.gnomAD v4.x: not in MyVariant.info (exomes are v2.1.1, genomes v3.1.1)

official popmax / grpmax / faf95.status: not parsed by the hub; af_popmax is in the index field list but carries no value
